# N3-B handoff ? separate review required

N3-A supplies only an explicitly imported disposable native writer, sharing N2's repository/lease. The production Task Service remains Legacy Adapter and Markdown/metadata authority. Read hosting exposes no execute/import/export API. No real root, production routing, migration, installation or reload is authorized.

Before N3-B, verify N3-A's sealed report and fresh source boundary. N3-B may propose pure application contracts and guarded synthetic translation fixtures, with a new exact allowlist after review. It must not silently split a compound editor save: existing native commands do not atomically combine metadata, completion and structure, and ordinary creation does not initialize nonempty continuation/Step bodies. Clear-completed, Phase/milestone lifecycle and source-dependent actions have no equivalent native command. Preserve Necessity (`must`, `should`, null), endpoint restrictions and physical Resource ownership through mounts.

Writer requests bind all stable command/admission evidence in existing private receipts. Fresh capabilities are authority/owner/family scoped; ready-only admission blocks even replay while recovering. Relocation is same-owner only. Retained/reconstructed handles and captured permits must not bypass the core publication gate. Uncertain publication requires authoritative reconciliation and identical operation replay; never replace identities or successors because a receipt is unavailable.

N3-C needs its own durable coordination design review. Task completion/event/binding/receipt is native-local atomicity; plugin data, Inbox, Oath saves, identity plans and source writes are separate authorities. No durable coordinator, native Oath record, outcome ledger or latch repair exists. Ordinary/restored Oath enrollment stays causally unproven; preserve F2's explicit closed synthetic save-ack/open-cut/later-completion sequence and known unsaved-latch loss. Committed parent trees remain under their original authority through terminal Oath state.

Preserve all existing flat4 forensic restrictions, private-v4 authority admission, barriers, fences, reservation claims, immutable originals, recurrence policy and export guards. Existing legacy sharing exposure grants no native sharing permission. N4 owns packets/transport, N5 migration rehearsals, N6 activation. No automatic repairs, fence clearing, stale-lock removal or broader phase work. STOP FOR USER REVIEW.

Earlier F1/N2 observations document legacy Hub ID comments in shared Markdown, task metadata selected without an inner field allowlist, and an out-of-root `captureSource` path. This gate preserves those findings without adopting that behavior as a native sharing contract.
